name: Dataform
sku: Google Cloud Dataform, for transformation workflows in BigQuery.

transform.sql-transform.note: A service for analysts to develop, test, version and schedule SQL transformation workflows in BigQuery, written in SQLX files, following an ELT pattern.

orchestrate.dependency-dag.note: The ref function references tables without hard-coded names and builds a dependency tree that decides execution order. It orders Dataform's own actions only.

orchestrate.scheduling.note: Workflows can be scheduled, as part of the service's develop, test, version and schedule cycle.

bands.note: Assertions check that data is correct, such as uniqueness and null checks or custom conditions, as part of the workflow.

presentation.tagline: SQL transformation workflows for BigQuery, with dependencies and assertions.
